Keeper — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Consecrate the threshold: Ward one door/room/camp — first qliphothic or psychic intrusion each scene is blunted (−2 to its effect). Standard fee 90 marks (Soft Power).

Trick — Rite of Passage (1/scene): End one ongoing spiritual affliction on a willing subject.

Master step: the Keeper's Knack (Hearthlight) improves at this tier — see the class entry.
